use crate::model::{Shape, Pair};

pub struct Inner;
pub struct Config;

impl Shape {
    pub fn extra(&self) -> u8 { 0 }
}

impl Inner {
    pub fn run(&self) {}
    fn default() -> Self { Inner }
}

pub fn make_config(x: u8) -> Config { Config }
pub fn helper<T>(x: T) {}
pub fn load() -> u8 { 1 }

fn main() {
    let s = Shape::new("a", 1, |x| x);
    s.extra();
    Inner::run(&Inner);
    Pair::make();
    Kind::Unit;
    Config::missing();
    helper(load());
    obj.run();
    a.b.extra();
}
